sn48.50:7.4: giving up unskillful qualities and embracing skillful qualities. They’re strong, staunchly vigorous, not slacking off when it comes to developing skillful qualities.
sn48.50:7.5: For their energy is the faculty of energy.
sn48.50:8.1: You can expect that a faithful and energetic noble disciple will be mindful, with utmost mindfulness and alertness, able to remember and recall what was said and done long ago.
sn48.50:8.2: For their mindfulness is the faculty of mindfulness.
sn48.50:9.1: You can expect that a faithful, energetic, and mindful noble disciple will, relying on letting go, gain immersion, gain unification of mind.
sn48.50:9.2: For their immersion is the faculty of immersion.
sn48.50:10.1: You can expect that a faithful, energetic, mindful noble disciple with their mind immersed in samādhi will understand this:
sn48.50:10.3: No first point is found of sentient beings roaming and transmigrating, shrouded by ignorance and fettered by craving.
sn48.50:10.4: But when that dark mass of ignorance fades away and ceases with no residue left behind, that state is peaceful and sublime.
sn48.50:10.5: That is, the stilling of all activities, the letting go of all attachments, the ending of craving, fading away, cessation, extinguishment.’
sn48.50:10.6: For their noble wisdom is the faculty of wisdom.
sn48.50:11.1: When a noble disciple has tried again and again, recollected again and again, entered immersion again and again, and understood with wisdom again and again, they will be confident of this:
sn48.50:11.2: ‘I have previously heard of these things.
sn48.50:11.3: But now I have direct meditative experience of them, and see them with penetrating wisdom.’
sn48.50:11.4: For their faith is the faculty of faith.”
